newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Half Portuguese labour have precarious jobs - study.
newsitem.headline: Half Portuguese labour have precarious jobs - study.

text.p: Almost half of Portugal's active population of 4.25 million people have "precarious" jobs, according to a study published in Publico newspaper on Monday.

The study conducted by sociologists of the Employment Ministry said almost two million people were paid on a piecemeal basis or had 24-hour contracts or worked from home, without the benefit of stable contracts.
"The data shows the precariousness of a large share of the jobs now available in the Portuguese economy," the paper said.
The study was a survey of 45 companies in seven districts, covering 15 activities, conducted last November, it said.
Portuguese unemployment stood at 7.2 percent of the workforce in the fourth quarter of 1996, according to the latest available official figures.
